name: tm-dashboard
description: Live task board for .bytedesk/task-management. HTTP + SSE, tails events.jsonl. The port is assigned once — probed free above 45000, then kept, so the project opens at the same URL every time — and written to .bytedesk/task-management/dashboard.port (TM_DASHBOARD_PORT to pin one). Runs while the plugin is enabled.

name: tm-pool
description: Agent-first pickup loop for .bytedesk/task-management: each tick collects finished dispatched workers, then dispatches ready-for-agent tasks up to dispatch.poolWip (default 3), preferring touches-disjoint sets. Opt-in: the --auto loop exits 0 immediately unless the store sets dispatch.enabled=true (`tm config dispatch '{"enabled":true}'`). Explicit control is `tm pool once|start|stop|status`, which works regardless.
